punchline: Brown's answer to fitting in is to give yourself permission to be who you are, in writing if needed.
thirty_sec: Brené Brown separates fitting in from belonging. Fitting in is conforming to what others expect, like nodding along to avoid a fight. True belonging means feeling secure enough to live your values whatever others think. She began with permission slips to herself, the first saying she was allowed to be goofy, have fun and enjoy life.
